name: AdvancedSearchSrReconciliationProposalEngine
input: one complete published non-noop advanced_search_sr source population plus stable LLD-02/03/06 readers; recovery runs use identical proposal computation but acceptance remains locked by exact recovery review
identity_flow: resolve each conflict-free canonical eight-digit SR through LLD-03 ServiceRequestImportReader.get_by_official
missing identity emits sr_create_or_adopt proposal; exact existing manual/source SR is adopted in place and service_request_id/local identity/history survive
approximate descriptive evidence never selects an existing SR
source_projection_flow: compare every active field against LLD-03 current accepted source projection using field-specific usability and source chronology

missing/unknown/malformed evidence never clears recognized current value unless the field contract explicitly allows clear; Current Handler accepted blank is such a source-display clear but changes no Contact
recognized terminal entry remains source projection evidence; terminal-to-nonterminal reversal is split into high-risk reviewed correction
Suspension Duration blank/zero after prior accepted nonzero is split into high-risk reviewed regression correction; no inferred duration is generated
customer_reconciliation: when usable Customer Account Code exists, use LLD-02 CustomerAccountCodeReviewService/ReferenceMatcher governed exact claimant semantics first; multiple claimants remain ambiguous
Customer Org. label is descriptive candidate evidence only and may refine/display review but never establish identity by itself
unknown/ambiguous Customer Organization never blocks otherwise valid SR source acceptance

emit reviewed sr_customer_reconciliation only for an exact bounded candidate/correction; acceptance invokes LLD-03 ServiceRequestImportMutationService.set_customer_from_review, which owns history-preserving SR Customer relationship and LLD-06 classification consequences in the same UoW
contact_reconciliation: Customer Contact and Current Handler are separate source facts and produce separate candidate contexts
candidate matching uses LLD-02 ReferenceMatcher.match_contact; equal name alone never selects identity
Current Handler source projection remains text authority even if a Contact is reviewed/associated; there is no competing local Current Handler string
unknown/ambiguous Contact never blocks otherwise valid SR source acceptance

sr_contact_reconciliation acceptance invokes LLD-03 ServiceRequestImportMutationService.set_customer_contact_from_review; sr_current_handler_reconciliation invokes set_current_handler_contact_reference_from_review and can resolve only the exact current accepted source observation
minimal Contact creation, when a UI flow offers it, remains a separate explicit LLD-02 command and is never an import auto-mutation
source_disappearance: derive new valid SR population identity set only after complete workbook parse/conflict classification
compare to prior accepted Advanced Search population represented by source evidence/checkpoint, never arbitrary current Service Request table contents

omitted prior identity emits sr_source_disappearance_review with evidence_mode=population_absence bound to current complete import_run and prior_source_observation_id; no current source observation or field is fabricated
acceptance invokes LLD-03 ServiceRequestImportMutationService.apply_source_disappearance_review; it may record governed warning/review projection only and never delete/archive/finalize the SR
reappearance uses the same immutable SR and reviewed warning state may be resolved without recreating identity

proposal_kinds.target_owner: LLD-03 source projection with LLD-06 SLA consumption

proposal_binding: observed-row proposal fingerprint binds exact source observation/field hashes/profile+registry versions/change set and target identity
population-absence proposal fingerprint binds exact complete import_run plus prior accepted source_observation identity and current target review state
base_state token binds current SR/source projection/reference context plus exact Customer/Contact matcher generations and revisions needed by proposal kind

sr_customer_reconciliation encodes exactly one ProposalChangeV1 with field_key=customer_org_id, change_kind=set, value_kind=identity, before=current active customer_org_id or null, after=the exact reviewed LLD-02 customer_org_id, integer values null, and source_observation_field_id pointing to the strongest individual Advanced Search Customer evidence field used for review explanation (Customer Account Code when usable, otherwise Customer Org. label); the proposal fingerprint additionally binds every source field/hash and matcher input used to produce that reviewed candidate so the single evidence pointer is never treated as the complete matching basis

acceptance of sr_customer_reconciliation reruns the governed LLD-02 match/current-reference checks inside the writer UoW and requires the current exact reviewed candidate to equal ProposalChangeV1.after; unresolved, ambiguous or changed evidence is stale and cannot mutate the SR relationship

accepted sr_customer_reconciliation creates/supersedes LLD-03 relationship history with origin_kind=advanced_search_review and the immutable reconciliation_proposal_id; proposal encoding never writes LLD-02 Customer master data or selects a Contract Product Line

sr_contact_reconciliation encodes exactly one ProposalChangeV1 with field_key=contact_id, change_kind=set, value_kind=identity, before=current active customer_contact contact_id or null, after=the exact reviewed LLD-02 contact_id, integer values null, and source_observation_field_id pointing to the exact usable Advanced Search customer_contact_label field in the proposal source observation that produced the candidate; proposal fingerprint additionally binds the matcher scope and all matcher inputs used for the reviewed candidate

sr_current_handler_reconciliation encodes exactly one ProposalChangeV1 with field_key=contact_id, change_kind=set, value_kind=identity, before=current active current_handler_reference contact_id or null, after=the exact reviewed LLD-02 contact_id and integer values null; source_observation_field_id points to the immutable LLD-04 current_handler_label field already referenced by the exact current accepted LLD-03 Current Handler source observation, so that support field may predate the current ImportRun when equal source text correctly produced no redundant LLD-03 observation; the proposal fingerprint separately binds the current ImportRun source observation/current-handler field hash and all matcher inputs, and the current usable import label must equal the accepted current-handler value

acceptance of either Contact reconciliation reruns the governed LLD-02 Contact match plus LLD-03 current reference/source checks inside the writer UoW, requires the exact reviewed Contact candidate to remain uniquely resolved and equal ProposalChangeV1.after, and treats target lifecycle, affiliation, matcher-scope, source-pointer or current-handler drift as stale; Current Handler acceptance additionally proves the current proposal observation still carries the same usable handler label as the accepted supporting field; accepted relationship history uses origin_kind=advanced_search_review and preserves reconciliation_proposal_id without mutating LLD-02 Contact identity or affiliation
one proposal covers the smallest independently reviewable/committable mutation scope
acceptance reruns all state-dependent identity/revision/reference/freshness checks in one outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork
auto_accept: No Advanced Search domain-changing proposal is auto-accepted in Beta 1.0; replay/no-change mechanics may remain automatic only because they perform no domain mutation.
closed_cross_packet_contracts: LLD-03 owns one active history-preserving canonical SR Customer Organization relationship; source Customer labels/account code are LLD-04 evidence and LLD-02 matching inputs only.

LLD-03 owns SR customer_contact and current_handler_reference relationship history; LLD-02 owns Contact identity/affiliation; current_handler_reference never supplies source text and is current only when bound to the exact current accepted handler source observation.

LLD-03 sr_source_field_observations persists exact FK source_observation_field_id into LLD-04 immutable published field evidence; LLD-04 SrSourceEvidenceProvider validates canonical SR/field/value/profile equivalence inside the caller UoW.
LLD-06 consumes canonical SR Customer/source SLA facts through owner interfaces and never guesses Customer identity from source labels.
construction_gate: Cross-packet ownership required for Advanced Search SR reconciliation is exact; remaining readiness depends only on LLD-04 V2 packet mechanics/integrity and later global regression/formal review gates.
